prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1074; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a parking lot collision between two insured vehicles at a retail lot. Insured reports a low-speed rear impact while reversing out of a space. Claimant vehicle sustained rear bumper damage. Claimant reports a head strike against the interior window frame and has since been diagnosed with a concussion. Claimant is represented by counsel; all contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Liability review pending.

Entry 2: Received letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Requested itemized medical records and the treating physician's notes related to the concussion diagnosis. Attorney advised that a demand package will follow once treatment is complete. Scheduled property damage inspection of claimant vehicle with the repair facility. Photos and estimate requested from the shop.

Entry 3: Reviewed parking lot surveillance footage provided by the property owner. Footage shows both vehicles in motion at low speed, with the insured's vehicle backing into the claimant's path. Camera angle partially obscures the moment of contact. Requested the complete unedited file and the property's incident report. Preliminary fault assessment leans toward the insured, pending the full footage review.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding the injury claim. Attorney indicated the client continues to experience headaches and light sensitivity and has been referred to a neurologist. Requested the neurologist's report and any imaging results once available. Advised that the company is evaluating liability and will respond to the injury claim after medical documentation is received. Diary set for follow-up in thirty days.

Entry 5: Received the neurologist's preliminary report and imaging summary from claimant's attorney. Records confirm a concussion diagnosis with ongoing symptom management. Medical bills and treatment timeline under review by the injury unit. Coordinated with the property damage unit on repair status. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the injury component. Claim remains open pending completion of medical review and liability determination.
